description: This file contains function declarations for string manipulation and memory operations, acting as a header for string-related functions in the project.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to n characters from source to destination.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates source string to the destination.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strrchr
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to n characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string.

methods.name: strnlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string up to a maximum of count.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a particular value.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies n bytes from source to destination, handling overlapping areas.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies n bytes from source to destination.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Finds a character in a block of memory.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes the cache for a given memory region.
